bait_content.title: Cache Index Rebuild Required
bait_content.body: An abnormal shutdown was detected. The HTTP cache index is inconsistent (net::ERR_CACHE_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH). Safe-mode caching is enabled; page performance may be reduced. Rebuilding will validate entries, purge corrupted objects, and resync storage quotas. Active tabs may restart.
